questions.question: Which tag should be used to indicate text that carries strong importance or critical urgency?
questions.hint: It conveys semantic importance, not just bold font.
questions.explanation: <strong> indicates that its contents have strong importance, seriousness, or urgency.

questions.question: What is the difference between <em> and <i>?
options: <em> denotes stress emphasis that alters meaning, whereas <i> indicates an alternate voice or technical term without emphasis
<i> makes text bold, while <em> makes text underlined
There is no difference in modern browsers
questions.hint: Think of spoken inflection vs visual italicization.
questions.explanation: <em> represents stress emphasis of its contents, changing vocal inflection, while <i> represents an alternate voice or mood.

questions.question: Which tag is semantically designed for highlighting text for reference or search matches?
questions.explanation: The <mark> element represents text marked or highlighted for reference purposes due to its relevance.

questions.question: To display chemical formula H₂O, which tag is used for the number 2?
questions.explanation: <sub> renders text as subscript below the baseline, as in chemical formulas like H₂O.

questions.question: Which semantic tag represents keyboard input keys in tutorials?
questions.explanation: <kbd> represents user input from a keyboard, voice input, or other text entry devices.
